items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Well, with Don's band we got to play across from Isham Jones.

ctx.x: Well, black and white bands didn't get to see one another enough. We would play together but we could hear them and appreciate their great talent, of a guy like Teagarden and a guy like Miff Moe. [handwritten correction: 'Moe' written above 'Hoe']
Well, with Don's band we got to play across from Isham Jones. [handwritten correction: 'Isham' written above 'Eisam']
